I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1`, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — completed successfully.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0002`) describing the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the first incident-creation attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid creating a duplicate.
